research_notes: The eventual production cap may be workload-profile conditioned only if a single universal cap wastes material capacity and profile detection is reliable.
Otherwise a universal conservative cap is simpler and less failure-prone.
This follows the program's rule to reject complexity without measured benefit.
Likewise adaptive reserve should not be introduced merely because it is theoretically elegant.
Empirical indistinguishability should favor the simpler policy.
Current Phase A remains intentionally policy-neutral beyond the fixed pre-arm/gap contract.
